summary: Complete **`:server` backend + `:core` client methods** for `groups` (own colla + guest colles, `#RRGGBB` clothing colors, `socialLinks`, logos/images, derived `eventIds`/`achievementIds`/`memberIds`) and `achievements` (CRUD + logo), plus public `/api/v1/public/groups*` and `/api/v1/public/achievements`. **Server + `:core` only** (all web UI lives in `spec-configuracio`).
overview:
Backend slice delivering the complete private and public API for colla groups and achievements (required by Astro in Fase 2 and consumed by `spec-configuracio` UI in Fase 3).

**Source of truth:** `docs/especificacion-tecnica.md` v1.3 §4.4, §5.9, §6.1.1, §6.7 (grupos y logros), §6.8 (`/public/groups*`, `/public/achievements`), §12.2 · `docs/decisiones.md`.

**Prerequisites**
- `platform-schema-v02` (`groups` with seeded `is_own = 1` «Muixeranga d'Elx» and `groups_single_own` partial unique index, `achievements`).
- `platform-core-contract` (`Group*`, `Achievement*`, `SocialLinks`, `GeoPoint`, `PatchField`).
- `platform-server-auth`, `platform-files` (for `logo` and `image` uploads), `platform-openapi-deploy`.

**Key business & permission rules (`decisiones.md` & §5.9)**
- **Split write permissions (§4.4 / §6.1.1):**
  - `groups`: read by `member`+ and anonymous (`/public/groups*`); write (`POST`/`PATCH`/`DELETE /groups*`, `logo`, `image`) by **`board` and `admin` ONLY** (`403` for `member` and `technical`).
  - `achievements`: read by `member`+ and anonymous (`/public/achievements`); write (`POST`/`PATCH`/`DELETE /achievements*`, `logo`) by **`technical`, `board`, and `admin`** (`403` for `member`).
- **Own group protection:** `groups_single_own` enforces at most one `isOwn = true` row (`409 duplicate` if attempting to create or patch a second `isOwn = true`). Deleting the own group (`isOwn = true`) is forbidden (`409 in_use` / `422`).
- **Validation:** `faixa`, `shirt`, and `trousers` arrays must contain valid `#RRGGBB` hex colors (`422 validation_failed`); `website` and `socialLinks` URLs validated when non-null; `foundation` and `achievement.year` reasonable positive integers.
- **Derived fields on `Group` (§5.9):**
  - `eventIds`: IDs of **published** events where this group appears in `event_groups`.
  - `achievementIds`: IDs of `achievements` belonging to this `groupId` (ordered by `year DESC, title`).
  - `memberIds`: populated **only on the own group** (`isOwn = true`) and **only** with users satisfying `status = active && consent.publicProfile == true && !isMinor` (empty array `[]` on guest groups).
- **Public routes (`Cache-Control: public, max-age=300`):** `GET /api/v1/public/groups`, `GET /api/v1/public/groups/{id}`, and `GET /api/v1/public/achievements` (with optional `?groupId=` and `?year=` filters). Group and achievement images/logos are public via `FileAccessPolicy`.

**Acceptance (slice)**
- `./gradlew :server:test :core:jvmTest :core:compileKotlinWasmJs` passes.
- Permission matrix test explicitly verifies: `anonymous` (public only, 401 private), `member` (read only, 403 write on both), `technical` (`403` on `/groups` writes, **`200`/`201`/`204` on `/achievements` writes**), `board` & `admin` (full CRUD on both).
- Creating a second `isOwn = true` group returns `409 duplicate`; deleting the own group returns `409 in_use`.
- `Group.memberIds` never includes minors or members without `consent.publicProfile`.
- Invalid `#RRGGBB` color values in `faixa`/`shirt`/`trousers` return `422 validation_failed`.
- `OpenApiRouteSyncTest` passes.
shared_ui_policy: No Compose UI in this slice (`decisiones.md`). All `/configuracio` UI screens live in `spec-configuracio`; this slice ships the complete `:server` API and `:core` `MuixerangaApi` client methods.
out_of_scope:
- Web UI for `/configuracio` (`spec-configuracio`).
- Global web theme customization (fixed colla branding in `TabalaTheme`).
- Android, desktop, JS, iOS clients.

auth.server: Private read: `member`+. Write `groups`: `board`, `admin`. Write `achievements`: `technical`, `board`, `admin`. Public routes: anonymous.

components.name: GroupsAchievements.sq
components.usage: SQLDelight queries for `groups`, `achievements`, derived published `event_ids`, `achievement_ids`, public adult `member_ids` (for `is_own = 1`), and optimistic-locked updates.

components.name: GroupService + AchievementService
components.usage: Full CRUD for groups (all §5.9 fields incl. `socialLinks`, `faixa`/`shirt`/`trousers` hex color validation, `website`, `location`, `logo`/`image` via `FileStorageService`, single `isOwn` guard, forbid deleting own group) and achievements (`title`, `subtitle`, `year`, `groupId`, `eventId`, `logo` via `FileStorageService`).

components.name: GroupAchievementRoutes
components.usage: Mounts all 17 private + public endpoints for `/groups*` and `/achievements*` with proper role guards and `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300` on `/public/*`.

components.name: MuixerangaApi (groups & achievements extension)
components.usage: Ktor Client methods for full groups CRUD + logo/image upload & delete, and full achievements CRUD + logo upload & delete.

structure:
Backend + `:core` contract architecture:

```text
:core GroupsAchievementsApi  (consumed later by spec-configuracio UI)
  ↕ JSON + Multipart (Bearer)
:server GroupAchievementRoutes → GroupService / AchievementService (+ FileStorageService) → GroupsAchievements.sq
  ↑
Astro public site → GET /api/v1/public/groups, /public/groups/{id}, /public/achievements
```

sections.title: Derived Group relations & RGPD compliance (§5.9)
sections.description: Every `Group` response includes `eventIds` (only `published = 1` events linked via `event_groups`), `achievementIds`, and `memberIds`.
sections.behavior: `memberIds` is computed **only** when `group.isOwn == true` and strictly filters to users with `status = 'active'`, `consent_public_profile = 1`, and `!isMinor` (in `Europe/Madrid`). Guest groups always return `memberIds = []`.

sections.title: Hex colors, social links & media uploads
sections.description: `faixa`, `shirt`, and `trousers` are JSON string arrays in SQLite validated against `^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$`. `socialLinks` validates optional `instagram`, `facebook`, `x`, `youtube` URLs/handles.
sections.behavior: Logo and image endpoints (`PUT`/`DELETE`) delegate to `FileStorageService` (`max 10 MB`, JPEG/PNG/WebP, subject to `upload` rate limit) and remove replaced files from `FILES_DIR` post-commit.

endpoints.name: List groups
endpoints.notes: `member`+. Own group first, then sorted by `name`.

endpoints.name: Update group
endpoints.notes: `board`/`admin`. RFC 7386 with `version`; covers all §5.9 fields (`socialLinks`, `faixa`/`shirt`/`trousers`, `website`, `location`, etc.).

endpoints.name: Upload / delete group logo
endpoints.notes: Also `DELETE /api/v1/groups/{id}/logo`. `board`/`admin`. Max 10 MB; upload rate limit.

endpoints.name: Upload / delete group image
endpoints.notes: Also `DELETE /api/v1/groups/{id}/image`. `board`/`admin`. Max 10 MB; upload rate limit.

endpoints.name: Upload / delete achievement logo
endpoints.notes: Also `DELETE /api/v1/achievements/{id}/logo`. `technical`/`board`/`admin`. Max 10 MB; upload rate limit.

persistence: Uses SQLite v0.2 `groups`, `achievements`, `events`, `event_groups`, `users`, and `stored_files` via `GroupsAchievements.sq`. No new migrations.
